subject: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-101.turn3.draft.md
summary: The detailed turn-3 protocol substantively lands the accepted cache repair on both Linux and macOS: hash before purge, inode-only stat after purge and immediately before cold, no full-file read inside the cold/warm pair, and hash after the pair. It also preserves the target-process ISA/ABI observations, paired 10 percent rule, D-006 numerals, and readiness boundaries. CONSENT is nevertheless withheld because the D101-T2-MF-1 disposition row says stat is required immediately before each timed launch. That includes the warm launch and conflicts with both the dispatch requirement and the draft's own detailed cold-only sequence. With the file's bytes declared to be the contract and no precedence rule, this residual contradiction requires a one-line repair.

objections.title: The accepted-disposition row still requires stat before every timed launch, contradicting the cold-only split sequence
objections.finding: Line 32 says the accepted repair performs inode-only stat 'immediately before each timed launch.' The governed help/version sequence has two timed launches, cold and warm, so that sentence requires another stat before warm. The dispatch requirement says stat only immediately before cold. The operative detail at lines 86-94, 102-109, and 120-129 agrees with the dispatch: stat follows purge immediately before cold; cold then warm are immediate; only an unpurged doctor launch receives its own prelaunch stat. Because line 28 says the contract lives in this file's bytes, the contradictory disposition recital is not safely dismissible as non-normative and the draft supplies no precedence rule.
objections.impact: An implementer following the disposition table can insert a stat operation between cold and warm, while an implementer following the numbered sequence cannot. The operation is metadata-only and does not revive the full-file cache-warming defect, so this is SHOULD-FIX rather than MUST-FIX; it still leaves the supposedly accepted measurement sequence internally non-unique and prevents CONSENT under the dispatch rule.
objections.recommendedRepair: In the D101-T2-MF-1 disposition row, replace 'immediately before each timed launch' with wording identical to the detailed rule: inode-only stat after purge immediately before the cold launch, and before an unpurged doctor launch; no stat or hash inside the cold/warm pair. Do not alter the already-correct detailed sequences.
